matches.rationale: The ground truth concerns the beamforming gain for N receive/transmit antennas being miscalculated as N instead of N^2. Both findings instead discuss unrelated mathematical constructs — Eq. (7)'s subcarrier spacing/sample-rate inconsistency and the T-fold SINR/power gain claim tied to a unitary spreading matrix F_b. Neither finding references antenna-array beamforming gain or an N vs N^2 scaling error, so the locus (R1) does not match.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Describes a genuine but unrelated inconsistency in Eq. (7)'s subcarrier spacing versus the claimed numerical examples, not the beamforming N vs N^2 defect.
Flags an inconsistency between a unitary F_b matrix and a claimed T-fold SINR/power gain, which is a different mechanism from the N vs N^2 antenna beamforming gain error in the ground truth.
